name: Nutrigenomics
description: Generate personalised nutrition recommendations from your genetic data (23andMe, AncestryDNA, or VCF). Analyses 24 genes (28 SNPs) across 12 nutrient domains affecting nutrient metabolism, absorption, and food sensitivities. All processing is local—your data stays private.
author: David de Lorenzo

input_file.description: Path to genetic data file (23andMe .txt/.csv, AncestryDNA .csv, or VCF)

output_dir.description: Absolute path to the output directory (join with report_path/figures to get full paths)

report_path.description: Filename of generated Markdown report, relative to output_dir

figures.description: Filenames of generated visualizations (relative to output_dir)

metadata.data_privacy: All processing local, no external transmission
metadata.citation_format: See ATTRIBUTION.md for BibTeX, APA, and Chicago formats

security.notes: Processes local genetic data only. Does not transmit data externally. Does not generate executable shell scripts. Output files (report, figures, checksums) are written to a timestamped directory under the working directory and persist on disk until manually deleted. The input file is never copied into the output directory.
